name: Sichuan Em Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Em Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of new chemical materials worldwide. The company offers optical PET base films for automotive decoration, polarizer, touch module, industrial, and backlight module; multi-layer ceramic capacitors release base films, and dry films; and both sides coated PET base film for reflective film of biafacial glass modules.
